verification: Native Unix subprocesses run the compiled workdeck executable in an owned controlling PTY at source terminal dimensions.
A Rust VT parser interprets real terminal output and responds to terminal queries; keyboard and SGR mouse bytes enter through the PTY master.
Patch stdin uses a file descriptor and the ignored-input case uses a real pipe; neither replaces terminal keyboard input.
Wheel retries retain the source limit of 12 attempts with 700ms observation windows.
Tests assert visible source anchors, hidden chrome, file counts, sidebar stats, split rails, navigation and clean exit; read-only runs leave no .agents state.
This behavioral source-test translation does not establish full cell-buffer parity or native Windows execution.
